newsitem.title: INDIA: India ICICI mulls tapping US bond market.
newsitem.headline: India ICICI mulls tapping US bond market.

text.p: The Industrial Credit and Investment Corporation of India Ltd (ICICI) is looking at the possibility of tapping the U.S. bond market for funds, a top ICICI official said on Tuesday.
"Yes, we are planning to tap the U.S. market, but the amount, tenor, whether or not we'll go ahead -- it is all open at the moment," the official told Reuters.
"But we are keen and are proceeding seriously," he said.
Merchant bankers said ICICI was looking at raising over $100 million over a 10-year tenor.
ICICI is India's second largest term-lending bank.
